data.one_liner: A plugin for using the Repro Android/iOS SDK in Flutter applications.
data.what_it_does: Integrates the Repro native SDK into Flutter applications for tracking and push notifications. Allows initializing the Repro SDK and forwarding device tokens for push notifications.
use_when: You need to integrate the Repro analytics and push notification SDK into your Flutter app
You are using Repro services for campaign management or user tracking on Android and iOS
avoid_when: You are not using the Repro platform for analytics or engagement
You only need standard push notifications without the Repro SDK
strengths: Official plugin for Repro Android and iOS SDKs
Supports push notifications setup with Firebase and APNs
weaknesses: Requires manual native setup in Android and iOS projects
data.setup_notes: Requires adding Gradle dependencies and a custom Application class on Android, running pod install and updating AppDelegate on iOS, and optionally setting up Firebase for push notifications.

alternatives.name: onesignal_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative platform for push notifications and engagement.
